message.content:
Let \(J = \int \text{atan}(3*x)\,dx\). Use integration by parts with  
\(u = \text{atan}(3*x)\), \(dv = 1*dx\). Then  
\(du = 3/(1 + 9*x**2)*dx\), \(v = x\).

\[
J = x*\text{atan}(3*x) - \int x*3/(1 + 9*x**2)*dx
\]

For the remaining integral, set \(w = 1 + 9*x**2\), so \(dw = 18*x*dx\). Then

\[
\int x*3/(1 + 9*x**2)*dx = (3/18)*\int (1/w)*dw = 1/6*\ln(1 + 9*x**2)
\]

Thus

\[
J = x*\text{atan}(3*x) - 1/6*\ln(1 + 9*x**2)
\]

Since the original integral is \(-3*J\),

\[
\int -3*\text{atan}(3*x)\,dx = -3*x*\text{atan}(3*x) + 1/2*\ln(1 + 9*x**2) + C
\]

<answer>-3*x*atan(3*x) + 1/2*ln(1 + 9*x**2) + C</answer>
